Solar panel cleaning in Albany Creek, Brisbane: before and after.

Bird droppings, dust and baked-on grime had built up across this roof's solar array, blocking sunlight and cutting into the power the system could produce. Our crew cleaned every panel with purified water and specialised equipment that lifts the build-up without harming the glass. The panels are now clear and streak-free, ready to perform at their best.

Dirty panels can lose a meaningful share of their output, so regular cleaning helps you get the most from your system.

Jetstream Pressure Washing AU is a Brisbane exterior cleaning team. We clean solar panels, roofs, gutters, house exteriors, driveways and windows across Brisbane and surrounds, and our technicians are trained to work safely at heights.

Colorbond roof cleaning in Rochedale, Brisbane: before and after. The left photo shows a white metal roof caked in leaf litter, mould spots and black grime. The right photo shows the same style of roof after our soft wash roof clean, bright white again, with the solar panels sitting on a clean surface.

A dirty roof does more than look tired. Moss, lichen and mould hold moisture against the surface, can block gutters and valleys, and make a house hotter in summer. Our team cleans roofs safely at heights using low pressure soft washing, so there is no damage to the roof or the paint finish, and we clear debris from roof valleys, gutters and around solar panels as part of the job.

We service Rochedale and suburbs across Brisbane, including roof cleaning, house washing, gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning and driveway pressure cleaning. Fully insured, upfront pricing and a tidy finish every time.

Free quotes: call 1300 983 918 or visit jetstreampressurewashing.au

Solar panel cleaning in Buccan, Logan area: before and after. On the left, panels coated in dust, grime and lichen build-up along the frames. On the right, the same system after our solar clean, clear glass and ready to perform.

Dirty panels lose efficiency. Dust, bird droppings, pollen and lichen block sunlight from reaching the cells, and the build-up is worst along the lower edge where it sits. We clean the full panel surface with purified water and soft brushes, no harsh chemicals, so the glass and frames are not damaged. Our team is trained and insured for working safely at heights.

We clean solar panels across Brisbane, Logan, Ipswich, Moreton Bay and surrounding suburbs, and can combine it with a roof clean, gutter clean or house wash to save you a second visit.

Free quotes: call 1300 983 918 or visit jetstreampressurewashing.au

Metal roof cleaning in Moorooka, Brisbane: before and after. The left photo shows a metal roof streaked with black mould, algae and years of grime. The right photo shows the same roof after our professional soft wash roof clean, bright, clean and protected.

Mould and algae on a metal roof don't just look bad. They hold moisture against the surface, break down the paint finish over time and can end up in your gutters and downpipes. We apply a specialised treatment to break down the organic growth, then rinse with controlled low pressure so the roof is cleaned without damage. Our crew works safely at heights and takes care of the surrounding gardens and house.

Based in Moorooka, we service roof cleaning, gutter cleaning, house washing, solar panel cleaning and driveway pressure cleaning right across Brisbane. Fully insured with upfront pricing.

Free quotes: call 1300 983 918 or visit jetstreampressurewashing.au

Terracotta tile roof cleaning in Corinda, Brisbane: before and after. The left photo shows a concrete tile roof covered in black mould and lichen streaks, with dull, patchy tiles from ridge to valley. The right photo shows the same style of roof after our roof pressure clean, with the tiles back to a rich, even terracotta colour.

Dirty tiles are more than a cosmetic problem. Mould, lichen and algae hold moisture against the surface, break down the tile finish over time and can clog valleys and gutters. Our crew cleans tile roofs safely at heights using a controlled, variable-pressure clean that lifts the growth without damaging the tiles, and we rinse down gutters and clear roof debris as part of the job.

We service Corinda and suburbs across Brisbane, including roof cleaning, house washing, gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning and driveway pressure cleaning. Fully insured, upfront pricing and a tidy finish every time.
